'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You really gave me a hand with those mules back then. Now everything seems to be ready for retail, but there's not enough momentum to revitalize our economy. Let's show this town how to market!}}

==Objectives==
* Sell [[Ragman]] any 250 [[backpacks]] or [[tactical rigs]]

==Rewards==
* +32,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.01'''</font>
* 264,000 Roubles
** 277,200 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 303,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 2× [[Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine]]
{{quote|Now that's more like it! Thank you, brother.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to sell any 250 [[backpacks]] or [[tactical rigs]] to [[Ragman]].

The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
